summary: Category leader in IT/enterprise workflow; Q3 2026 subscription revenue +21%, FY26 guide +22.5%, AI ACV target raised to $1.7B. Growth slowly decelerates; GAAP margin rises as stock-based pay shrinks relative to revenue.

rationale.growthHigh: Q3 2026 subscription growth 21% and cRPO +20.5%; assume ~18% average over 5 years as the base gets larger.
rationale.targetMargin: Non-GAAP operating margin is ~32%, GAAP ~10-15% because of stock-based pay; a mature GAAP margin of ~28% treats that pay as a real cost.
rationale.salesToCapital: Asset-light software; mostly capitalised R&D and data centres.
rationale.exitMultiple: 35x year-5 earnings: still ~10%+ growth then, in line with large-cap software quality names.

thesis.text: ServiceNow is the system of record for enterprise workflows, and AI agents raise what customers pay per seat. Growth is slowing from the mid-20s to around 20%, but cash generation is strong and the business is sticky.
bull: AI agent products (Now Assist) lift price per customer; AI ACV target raised to $1.7B for 2026
Expanding beyond IT into CRM, HR and finance workflows
bear: AI agents from Microsoft, Salesforce and start-ups could compress seat-based pricing
Stock-based pay keeps GAAP margins far below adjusted margins
Federal spending and large-deal timing can make quarters lumpy
watch: Quarterly subscription growth vs the ~20% trend

changes.text: First Claude base case and thesis.
